nodes.content: Design a distributed query-result cache preserving transaction snapshot semantics across concurrent writes, range predicates, and replica lag.
requirements: Every cached result must match uncached execution at the transaction’s snapshot, including during failover.
Reduce p95 read latency 30% versus uncached execution at 80% reads and 20% writes.

nodes.content: Cache MVCC snapshot-interval results using commit-ordered key/range invalidations; serve only with failover-fenced watermarks covering the snapshot, otherwise bypass.
How are range-result validity intervals closed for phantom writes when invalidations lag or a cache owner fails over?
Durable commit-indexed range invalidations close intervals at write commit; fenced owners serving only replay-covered snapshots yield zero phantom hits.
Run PhantomFence-10M: interleave range inserts, delayed invalidations, and owner failovers; compare every cache hit against MVCC snapshot execution.
PhantomFence-10M found 0/6.2M cache-hit mismatches across 400 owner failovers and 250 ms invalidation lag.
Given PhantomFence-10M’s zero mismatches, adopt commit-indexed range invalidations with fenced replay watermarks; require separate p95 validation before rollout.
Implement fenced range cache; benchmark 80/20 workload under replica lag and failover, requiring zero snapshot mismatches and ≥30% p95 reduction.
Implement the fenced cache; benchmark ReadMix-80/20 against uncached MVCC across 1M snapshot-checked queries, 250 ms replica lag, and failovers.
ReadMix-80/20 benchmark report records 0/1M snapshot mismatches and 35% lower p95 versus uncached under replica lag and failovers.
Audit ReadMix-80/20 report against raw traces, recomputing snapshot mismatches and p95 speedup separately for failover and replica lag.
Trace audit confirmed 0/1M snapshot mismatches; p95 fell 34% during failover and 32% at 250 ms replica lag.
Transactionally maintained MVCC range-generation counters, read from snapshot-qualified replicas, should prevent phantom hits despite delayed invalidations and owner failover.
Run GenFence-10M with concurrent range inserts, 250 ms replica lag, and owner failovers; compare generation-validated hits against snapshot execution.
GenFence-10M observed 9/5.4M phantom hits: post-failover shard epochs reused MVCC generation values, falsely validating pre-failover ranges.
How do independently advancing shard watermarks prevent mixed-version cache hits for cross-shard queries during distributed commits?
Gate cross-shard hits on commit-resolved snapshot tokens and all shards’ fenced replay watermarks; test partial commits and failover.
Run CrossShard-2PC: pause commits after one shard applies, fail over replicas, and compare token-gated hits against uncached snapshot reads.
CrossShard-2PC report records 0/2M mixed-version hits across 10,000 partial commits and 200 failovers, with per-shard watermark traces.
Cache immutable results by globally unique snapshot tokens, query fingerprints, and execution context; populate through snapshot-consistent reads.
How can snapshot-token caching preserve read-your-writes when transactions share a snapshot but differ in uncommitted local writes?
Bypassing shared cache after each transaction’s first local write should eliminate read-your-writes mismatches without changing read-only hit rates.
Replay CrossShard-2PC watermark traces with same-snapshot divergent local writes; compare bypassed reads against uncached results and measure read-only hit rates.
CrossShard-2PC replay found zero local-write mismatches, but read-only hit rate fell from 78% to 61% when bypass suppressed cache warmup.
Bypass write-transaction hits, but warm shared entries through independent read-only snapshot executions; restore ≥78% read-only hits without mismatches.
Replay CrossShard-2PC traces with independent read-only snapshot warming; measure read-only hit rate and local-write mismatches against uncached execution.
CrossShard-2PC replay yielded 72% read-only hits, below the 78% target, despite 0/2M local-write mismatches.
Replay CrossShard-2PC with per-snapshot top-100 query prewarming through independent read-only executions; measure hit rate and local-write mismatches.
Top-100 snapshot prewarming restored read-only hit rate to 79%, with 0/2M local-write mismatches across CrossShard-2PC replay.
Bypass shared cache after local writes; top-100 snapshot prewarming should maintain ≥78% read-only hits with zero mismatches.
Replay CrossShard-2PC traces with local-write bypass and top-100 snapshot prewarming; check read-only hit rate and snapshot mismatches.
Combined bypass and top-100 prewarming delivered 79% read-only hits and 0/2M snapshot mismatches in CrossShard-2PC replay.
Adopt local-write bypass with top-100 snapshot prewarming: simple warming missed 78%; combined replay reached 79% hits, zero mismatches.
Implement local-write bypass and top-100 snapshot prewarming; validate zero read-your-writes mismatches and ≥30% p95 reduction on ReadMix-80/20.
Implement local-write bypass and top-100 prewarming; run ReadMix-80/20 with concurrent writes, 250 ms lag, and failovers.
ReadMix-80/20 report records 0/1M snapshot mismatches and 33% lower p95 versus uncached with failovers and 250 ms lag.
Maintain predicate-indexed materialized results using globally ordered committed MVCC deltas; serve snapshot versions only after all participating shards catch up.
How can predicate-indexed results handle range phantoms and join deletions without retaining a full materialization for every snapshot?
Versioned predicate indexes and signed join deltas should reconstruct retained snapshots from periodic checkpoints without materializing every snapshot.
Augment ReadMix-80/20 traces with range inserts and join deletions; measure minute-checkpoint, predicate-indexed delta reconstruction accuracy and storage.
ReadMix-80/20: 0/1M snapshot mismatches on range inserts and join deletions; minute-checkpoint delta storage 18 GB versus 74 GB materialized.
Implement minute-checkpoint predicate indexes with range-insert and signed join deltas; validate failover snapshots and ≥30% ReadMix-80/20 p95 improvement.
Implement minute-checkpoint predicate indexes and signed join deltas; benchmark ReadMix-80/20 against uncached execution under range inserts and failovers.
ReadMix-80/20 delta-cache report records 0/1M snapshot mismatches and 31% lower p95 versus uncached across range inserts, joins, and failovers.
Audit ar4’s ReadMix-80/20 traces against MVCC snapshots, recomputing p95 and mismatches for failovers, range inserts, and join deletions.
ReadMix-80/20 trace audit confirmed 0/1M snapshot mismatches and 31% lower overall read p95; failover reads improved 30%.
